issue.title: Specific triage extractors for lint (pyscripts), lint (feature flags), lint (test waits), and SASE validation
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-18j.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3, E3 failure-triage epic sase-18j), triaged by sase-18j.land.

E3's v1 extractor registry in sase-core (`crates/sase_core/src/tool_run/triage/extractors/`) has specific extractors for symvision, mypy, ruff/fmt/keep-sorted, pytest, toobig, cargo test, and `_setup` environment markers. Every other failing `check` stage falls through to the generic fallback, whose items are always UNKNOWN (reason `extractor_generic`). So a KNOWN master-red failure in one of those stages still stops known-gated continuation and yields verdict `undetermined`.

Stages still on the generic fallback: `lint (pyscripts)`, `lint (feature flags)`, `lint (test waits)`, and `SASE validation`. Measured impact: sase-18j.2 found these in 33 of 442 failing stage sections in retained athena logs. The DoD-5 backtest (sase-191.3, 578 runs) labeled 75 items UNKNOWN for `extractor_generic`.

Scope: in sase-core, add versioned specific extractors for these stages, with golden fixtures taken from real, redacted athena stage output. Follow the existing normalization and signature rules. Then move sase's `sase-core-revision.txt` pin and re-run `tools/tool_triage_backtest` to confirm KNOWN precision stays >= 95% on a hand-audited sample.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add versioned sase-core triage extractors for the lint (pyscripts), lint (feature flags), lint (test waits), and SASE validation stages, so that their master-red failures can be labeled KNOWN instead of always UNKNOWN (extractor_generic).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: E3 (sase-18j) deliberately shipped generic-only coverage for these stages in v1 and scoped its extractor registry to the stages that dominated the athena ledger. Adding stages needs new sase-core extractors, goldens, a pin move, and a backtest re-audit, which is separate from landing E3.
